text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Great work out there, Trainer

<username>. I had
the
pleasure of observing your training
session!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
The diligence of your trainee, your
infectious
passion—I love watching a
good dance practice,
but this was just as
impressive!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
All of us working behind the scenes will
have to
put together a great concert so
all that effort of
yours doesn't go to
waste!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I'm holding you up. Just know
I'll be
cheering you on!
